+_ACRONYM_RE = re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z])[A-Z]{2,}(?![a-z])")

 def titleize(word: str) -> str:
     """

+    result = re.sub(
         r"\b('?\w)",
         lambda match: match.group(1).capitalize(),
         humanize(underscore(word)).title()
     )
 
+    # Keep all-caps acronyms (e.g. NASA, HTTP) as written, but only when the
+    # input also contains lowercase letters; a fully uppercase input such as
+    # 'HELLO WORLD' is still treated as a shouted title.
+    if any(char.islower() for char in word):
+        for acronym in set(_ACRONYM_RE.findall(word)):
+            result = re.sub(
+                r"\b" + re.escape(acronym.capitalize()) + r"\b",
+                acronym,
+                result,
+            )
